reviews.text: I have a Yorkie tea cup with a broken arm. I went to 3 other vets and they were over charging. Prices ranging from 5 to 11 thousands. That’s not even including the exams and X-rays. Found Low cost vet online. No surgery, everything was done externally while my Yorkie was under sedation. My yorkies arm is fully healed. Vet charges less then 3500. He actually cares he’s not a vet for the money. Cannot thank this vet enough.

This vet was a lifesaver! My kitten needed emergency surgery due to a uterine condition. Since I didn't have an appointment available that day, they told me they would see her as soon as possible. The tests they performed were incredibly quick, and the surgery itself was swift and precise. Thank you so much from the bottom of my heart for being so understanding and explaining the recovery process for my pet! I wholeheartedly recommend this place. Their prices are extremely low compared to other vets, and the service and hospitality are excellent!

I had a really positive experience at Steinway Low Cost Vet Clinic. Finding affordable veterinary care can be difficult, especially when you are trying to make sure your pet gets the care they need without having to worry about an overwhelming bill.

What stood out to me most was how respectfully I was treated. The staff listened, allowed me to explain my concerns, and treated me like my questions were valid. I never felt embarrassed for asking questions or made to feel like I was an inconvenience.

The clinic provides an important service to the community by making veterinary care more accessible, but what makes the experience even better is that affordability does not seem to come at the expense of compassion or dignity.

I also appreciated that the staff understood that bringing a beloved pet to the veterinarian can be stressful. Having people communicate with patience and respect makes a huge difference during an already difficult experience.

If you are looking for affordable veterinary care, I would definitely recommend giving Steinway Low Cost Vet Clinic a try. You can get there easily by train, and most importantly, you feel heard, respected, and treated with dignity.

Affordable veterinary care can be compassionate veterinary care, and Steinway is a great example of that. Highly recommend! ❤️🐾 Thank you Dr. Ali and staff!!

Absolutely horrible experience with this vet holding my dogs heartworm medication hostage. Secretary on the phone states the dog hasn’t had her heartworm test in over year which when she checked was wrong as the last test was in October. I understand the years coming close but calling to schedule an appointment for that is obviously too much to ask they would rather reject your dogs heartworm medication from chewy on a Saturday of a holiday weekend so she can actually end up missing the pill for this month. This is the exact same medicine I got last year so I really don’t understand the logic of putting my dog more at risk of heartworm because you want to do an early check up. Found the receipt of the last time you guys gave my dog a heart worm check and it was in November actually so it's two months early this is ridiculous. To be blatantly lied to on the phone just for you to schedule a visit seems like extortion or at the very least exploitation. Edit: Hello Owner I see you responded just wanted to let you know the problem wasn’t the price which is about $15 cheaper on chewy the problem was instead of calling to schedule an appointment you rejected her important preventative medicine right before a holiday forcing things to delay even later instead of just calling me to schedule an appointment. I could of been there Tuesday or today if you had availability instead I got all my problems solved at petco for also $10 cheaper exam fee so I’ll be saving $25 versus your horrible low cost vet that would rather hold my dogs medicine hostage for a payday. Everyone please avoid this terrible Vet as the owner is remorseless clearly and rather argue with people online than genuinely help a pet. Like my whole problem is because you’d rather argue online and reject preventative measures when you could of easily called me to schedule an appointment and given me a 1 month script since it doesn’t expire til November. Sorry maybe I’m putting more thought in to your job than you do though.

Unfortunately I've had negative experiences with many clinics to the point we've almost felt doubtful anyone would want to help our cats. This is the first clinic who have genuinely cared for our cat and saved his life. The clinic is true to its name, so please do not hesitate to try this place. Your pets will thank you!

The doctor was so considerate with the compassionate examining and did a wonderful job when my baby had to have 2 tumors from her belly.
I definitely recommend this facility

Had a great experience, truly. Everyone was so kind and welcoming, from the front desk to the back office. We really appreciate that. Our dog is definitely on the anxious side when it comes to vet visits but the doctor and our vet tech, Summer, were both great with her. We were able to get our dog everything she needed without any issues. The whole experience went smoothly. Really thankful.
Every time I call, it's just an ai system. I was told a nurse would follow up with me to confirm, but I still haven't received a call.

I Always have a great Experienced at this Clinic, this is the 3th time I was here, Doctor Ali is a Great Vet and very kind with the pets, this time I went for a Dental consultation and I was very Lucky my dog got the dental cleaning the same day. He is 12 years old and I was very worried for the anesthesia ,he make sure he was in the right condition to have the procedure, everything went perfect ,my baby has cleaning teeth now and the most Important he is ok.🙏 I will continue coming every time my dog need it.

My dog, an older Maltese, sadly had a growing tumor in her breast and a Pyometra that we caught early, but would be fatal if not taken care of immediately. I had been recommended during an emergency visit to a VEG that I reach out to Queens low cost vet for support along with a handful of other vets. Once I contacted Queens vet, they scheduled the appointment that same day and booked her for a emergency surgery that same day as well, after a quick check up. They proceeded to do a risky procedure that would take care of both issues and not only successfully saved my dog, but also offered all the medicine, after care, and overnight monitoring. This whole package of things to make sure my dog was safe and healthy and they only charged me a little less than 4K. All the other places I reached out to were ready to charge me 7k per surgery, over 14k for both procedures, not including any medicine and such needed to keep her stable after her surgery. Because of the quick assistance and amazing skillset of the team over at Queens Low cost vet, my precious girl is able to continue her life. I can't begin to thank them enough for saving her. They truly do value pet lives more than money here.

We had such a great experience here. The staff was so incredibly kind and Dr. Ali was so kind and considerate. We couldn't afford the original amount we were quoted for the surgery at another clinic but alhamdulillah we were able to get it for an affordable price here. They treated our baby with such care and we are so glad we came to this clinic. Thank you for saving her. ❤️

Please do not bring your beloved pets here, unless you’re okay with your pets dying due to negligence on the staff’s part. This vet office is HORRIBLE! I had to CHASE the vet for answers after giving them over $600 for “tests”. This vet office incorrectly diagnosed my baby girl. I have yet to hear from them even though I’ve left voicemails, I’ve called relentlessly, and have texted them. NO RESPONSE! They don’t care for their patients! Please go anywhere else!

EDIT: They responded to my review with lies, my baby was BORN with FeLV, they didn’t diagnose her, they didn’t even test for it. And she was misdiagnosed with hypothyroidism, I got a second opinion that confirmed she did not have that. I HAD TO CHASE YOU GUYS FOR THE RESULTS OF ALL THE TESTS I PAID FOR! Of course my vm was nasty! And that was the LAST vm, the only reason you FINALLY responded to me, was BECAUSE this last one was nasty! You guys run a TERRIBLE PRACTICE! You DO NOT CARE FOR YOUR PATIENTS!

The clinic was exceptionally nice and well-organized, with very friendly staff.They inform you about all charges before proceeding, allowing you to decide what is truly necessary.The upselling of services is not aggressive and can definitely be    .avoided if you're on a budge

A Very Disappointing Experience

My experience with this veterinary clinic was extremely negative. The international travel health certificate they prepared for my dog contained errors, and as a result, I was unable to return to the United States with my dog as planned. I had no choice but to leave her in Colombia.

What makes this even worse is that I was charged for a service that was done incorrectly and ultimately was useless to me, yet the clinic has not had the courtesy to refund my money. Because of their mistake, I have had to leave my dog in Colombia and pay someone every week to take care of her. Even more disappointing is that they have not made any real effort to help me find a solution to bring my dog back to the United States.

Honestly, my impression was that the veterinarian was primarily interested in getting paid. I did not feel that he cared about my dog, about what I was going through as her owner, or about the emotional and financial impact this situation has caused me. His attitude felt completely heartless and lacking in compassion.

The clinic also presents itself as an affordable option, but my experience was completely different. I found their charges to be very high for procedures, vaccinations, and almost every service. Even simply examining the dog comes with a significant charge that, in my opinion, is not justified by the level of service provided.

A veterinary clinic should put the well-being of animals and the peace of mind of their owners first. In my case, I felt the complete opposite. They made a mistake that had very serious consequences for both me and my dog, charged me for a service they did not perform correctly, and then failed to take responsibility or show any genuine interest in helping me resolve the situation.

This experience has left me deeply disappointed, and based on everything that happened, I cannot recommend this clinic, especially for international travel documentation. On top of that, when I tried to get help from this veterinarian, he threatened to call the police... To me, this man is heartless; the only thing he cares about is money….Si usted lo que quiere es ahorrar dinero con su mascota hagalo pero los resultados no le van a gustar … este veterinario no se actualiza lo unico q le interesa es su dinero …

I don't recommend Dr. Ali. He tries to force you to pay for medications your dog doesn't need. After taking my two dogs there for almost two years and having receipts proving I never paid extra for any medication, he suddenly tells me my dog ​​needs something extra, and only because I said I would accept it. After waiting an hour, he refused to vaccinate my dog. Be very careful because I learned the hard way that cheap often ends up being expensive. I don't recommend him at all. 👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎
